tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search this merchant's enriched catalog with a natural-language query plus optional structured filters. Results are ranked against titles, merchandising fields, and Pollen's agent-oriented search terms, and include enriched descriptions. Product photos for the top 3 results arrive inline as image co

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch one product by ID with full enrichment: agent-optimized description, structured facts (attribute/value/confidence), search terms, variants, price, and a dataAsOf timestamp for freshness. The product photo is returned inline as an image content block by default (set include_image=false to skip

tools.name: get_variants
tools.description: List a product's variants: options (size/color/etc.), SKU, barcode, price, compare-at price.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Report a product's listing status, purchasable variants, and prices from the canonical catalog. IMPORTANT: this reflects the merchant's last catalog sync (see dataAsOf), not a live inventory call - treat as 'listed and priced', and confirm stock at checkout.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Recommend products within this merchant's catalog. intent=similar (same type / overlapping tags as a reference product), complementary (same brand or shared tags, different type), or trending (the catalog's strongest enriched products). Ranked by agent-readiness quality.

tools.name: cart_add
tools.description: Add items to a cart for this store. Omit cartId on the first call to create a cart; pass the returned cartId on later calls. Items take variantId (from get_variants/get_product) or productId for single-variant products, plus quantity. The cart lives with this conversation (24h) - nothing touches the

tools.name: cart_update
tools.description: Change quantities in an existing cart. Set an item's quantity to 0 to remove it. Returns the updated cart.

tools.name: cart_view
tools.description: Show a cart's lines, quantities, and estimated subtotal (estimate from the last catalog sync; the store's checkout computes exact totals, taxes, and shipping).

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Turn a cart into a checkout link on the merchant's OWN store, with the items preloaded. Pass cartId, or inline items (same shape as cart_add) for a one-shot handoff without a session cart. Returns the link plus a line-item summary to relay to the shopper. The store's checkout - not Pollen - computes

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: The store's PUBLISHED policy pages: returns/refunds, shipping, terms, privacy. Use these to answer shopper questions about returns windows or shipping regions - quote or link the store's own pages. Anything the checkout computes (exact tax, shipping cost for an address, delivery dates) is not answer
